title: Head to Head: who the engines pick when a buyer asks A or B. October 2026.
description: From the September 2026 Absence Index deposit (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22907695; verbatim answers from ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews and Google AI Mode, three repeats per question), we read every answer to a head to head question ("A vs B") and every answer to an alternatives question ("alternatives to X") across 14 categories. We report how often an answer declares a single winner, who wins, whether the five engines agree, whether the winner is the more-named vendor in the Index, and what the winning answers cite.
